title: Phone validation rejects required leading-zero format
impact: Blocks required profile completion with a spec-conforming phone
recommendation: Align validation and error copy with FR-04
retest_criterion: 10/11-digit leading-zero values save and persist; non-leading-zero value is rejected

title: Login password is rendered as plaintext
impact: Exposes credentials on screen and in recordings
recommendation: Use a masked password control by default
retest_criterion: Password remains masked by default across supported browsers; optional reveal is explicit and reversible

title: Phone error recovery requires repeated unsupported attempts
impact: Repeated errors prevent or distort completion of SC3
recommendation: Fix validator and show the exact accepted format with field-linked feedback
retest_criterion: At least 5/5 retest users save a valid leading-zero phone on first update attempt without assistance

title: Password-policy recovery causes repeated registration attempts
impact: P04 recovers after one error while P06 does not complete registration by confirmed task end
recommendation: Show a live password-policy checklist and state-specific feedback while typing
retest_criterion: 5/5 retest users create a compliant password and register with at most one validation error

title: Username label does not communicate that full email is required
impact: One failed login and about five seconds of hesitation before self-recovery
recommendation: Label the field Email and use login-specific Vietnamese copy
retest_criterion: 5/5 retest users select the correct identifier on the first login attempt

title: Browser password-manager detour interrupts login
recommendation: Review autocomplete semantics and password-manager integration
retest_criterion: No unintended browser settings navigation in 5/5 supported-browser retests
